newsitem.title: USA: Acres Gaming wins $6.1 mln order from IGT.
newsitem.headline: Acres Gaming wins $6.1 mln order from IGT.

text.p: Acres Gaming Inc said on Thursday that International Game Technology (IGT) has ordered $6.1 million of Acres' Concept III player tracking components for IGT'S Smart System gaming machines and new game sound kits.
The parts will be delivered starting in December 1996 and running through February 1997, Acres said in a statement.
In August, 1996, Acres Gaming and IGT formed an alliance to integrate technology in several product areas.
"Our excitement about the possibilities of working with IGT continues to grow," said Joe Huseonica, Acres president.
